name: codex-recent-change-quality-loop
title: codex-recent-change-quality-loop
description: Inventory recent committed and uncommitted changes, review independent slices concurrently with bounded read-only fanout, reduce findings, and delegate blocking fixes until no high or mid findings remain.

workflow.title: codex-recent-change-quality-loop
workflow.description: Review code changes introduced within a configurable recent time window, including uncommitted changes, and delegate any blocking findings into the design-and-implement workflow before re-reviewing until no high or mid findings remain.
